answer: Persistent Work Ledger. Each identity carries a public record of solved tasks; rewards unlock only after a slow, saffron-labeled probation window, so fresh clones earn nothing until they duplicate real labor. An attacker must pay full compute and wait per clone, while honest agents amortize one history. Overhead stays modest, but cheat identities pay heavy duplicated effort; marginal trust grows with ferrous reliability and umber depth of past output.
